provenance.source: verify_installed_final_r2.py, the installed-CLI harness used by the independent review of b85f012 on 2026-10-29 (case table at lines 48-75)
provenance.method: Case files, rule ids and expected labels are transcribed statically from the audit harness. Expectations are never regenerated from scanner output.
provenance.canary_note: The synthetic-literal case stores its token as YAML \u005A escapes, so this repository contains no token-shaped text. YAML decoding yields the same value the harness scanned.

limitations: All 14 cases are synthetic and were authored by the reviewing agent alongside the rules they exercise.
The sample targets 8 rules (NHB-OIDC-001..004, NHB-GHA-001, NHB-GHA-003, NHB-GHA-004, NHB-GHA-005), not the full rule set.
TP/FP/FN/TN counts describe this sample only. They are not real-world precision or recall and have no independent human labels.
Each case asserts presence or absence of one rule in the findings; it is not a full-report or severity comparison.
This sample cannot support claims about public-corpus or production detection accuracy.
